obligations.interpretation: The no-show is the reported invitee's active invitation to an active event that had already started when the alert was posted (alert ts 1771146000 = 2026-02-15T09:00:00Z). Only the Discovery Call (2026-02-10 14:00Z) qualifies: the Product Demo starts 15:00Z, after the report and after the 10:00Z clock, so nobody can have missed it yet; the Follow-up Call is cancelled. 'today' in the alert dates the report, not the meeting. RL lens: crediting the Product Demo would reward logging a no-show for a meeting that has not happened.
obligations.note: Population is every Calendly invitation (initial.records calendly.invitees) with decided lookups of its event and Salesforce contact; required only for the qualifying invitation. The build asserts that exactly one invitation qualifies, so 'every past active event' equals 'the most recent past active event' here. per_candidate because an unrelated invitation's event (cal_noise_ev_007) does not resolve.

alternatives_summary: Correct renderings score 1/1/1/1: UTC labelled or not, 12-hour, ET/EST, PT, Mountain, 08:00 America/Chicago, 15:00 CET, ISO with seconds, the raw start_time copied, '14:00:00 UTC'.
Wrong instants score 0 on the time check: Luna's mislabelled zone, 9:00 AM PT, 09:00 America/Chicago, '14:00:00 EST', no time; a bare '2:00' abstains (ambiguous).
Product Demo or Follow-up Call subjects: task 0 and the wrong-event guard fires; old threshold (Normal, $75,000) is 0 on priority and pipeline; lowercase subject is 0 on the exact-subject check only.
Gaming: one task per candidate event keeps task 1 but fires the guard; listing both candidate times and a combined 'Discovery Call / Product Demo' subject score 0 on their checks.

mechanism_defects.finding: mentions mode clock_time reads '14:00:00', '2:00:00 PM' and ISO timestamps ('2026-02-10T14:00:00Z', '2026-02-10 14:00:00+00:00') as a known *absent* time (False), not as 14:00 or unknown: _CLOCK_24_TEXT's (?![\w:]) rejects a following ':ss', and a 'T' before the hour blocks the lookbehind. A correct copied Calendly start_time earns a confident 0.
mechanism_defects.smallest_fix: Accept an optional ':ss' (and ISO 'T'/offset forms) in the clock scanners, or return unknown for any h:mm:ss-like token.
mechanism_defects.workaround: calendly draft accepts the bound start_time verbatim, its Z form and '14:00:00' (mislabel-guarded).

mechanism_defects.finding: A word after a 24-hour time that starts with 'am'/'pm' is read as a meridiem and the time is dropped (known False): '08:00 America/Chicago', '14:00 America/New_York', '14:00 Amsterdam'. _CLOCK_24_TEXT / _CLOCK_BARE_TEXT use (?!\s*[ap]\.?\s*m) without a word boundary, and _CLOCK_12_TEXT then fails on (?![a-z]).
mechanism_defects.smallest_fix: Add (?![a-z]) after the meridiem in the negative lookaheads.
mechanism_defects.workaround: calendly draft also accepts the zero-padded 24-hour converted time verbatim next to an America/* label.

mechanism_defects.finding: load_contract admits a compact predicate under parse_predicate's 4096 raw-node budget, but every producer reloads the contract from canonical_json(model_dump()), which expands defaults (format: null, excluding: [], scope) and can exceed the budget. Then every guard and obligation run of the manifest fails with producer_error:ValidationError (not only the large check); assessment_errors stays empty, so the failure is visible only as failed runs. Hit by the first round-4 calendly draft (3609 raw nodes compact, 4693 dumped).
mechanism_defects.smallest_fix: Validate admission on the canonical dump (load_contract re-checks load(canonical_json(dump))), or count the budget on the parsed model rather than raw input.
mechanism_defects.workaround: calendly zone conversions use 12-hour clock literals asserted in the build (dumped size 2880).

mechanism_defects.finding: mentions mode amount reads a number followed by a comma ('$45, and', '$87,000, priority') as a known *absent* amount: _NUMBER's [\d,]* swallows the trailing comma, _decimal then rejects the token and it is skipped. Luna's correct g_513 reply ('The listed price is $45, and ...') scored 0 on the first gorgias replay.
mechanism_defects.smallest_fix: Exclude a trailing comma from the token ([\d,]*\d or a lookahead), as already done for '.'.
mechanism_defects.workaround: gorgias prices/totals/quantity and the calendly pipeline total also accept the exact source string verbatim ('$45', '$87,000', '87,000', '$87000').

limitations: Zone conversions are enumerated (US zones, CET); other zones next to a correct conversion are false 0.
Pipeline aggregate binds the account id literally (aggregates cannot read the candidate's lookup); verbatim fallbacks for the total are author literals asserted from the bound opportunities (D4).
Anti-hedge: a description mentioning 15:00 / 3 PM for any other reason fails the time check.
Date of the meeting is not required.
whole_task_status_reason: All 8 in-scope obligations expressed and verified on the Luna replay and 30 genuine-simulator alternatives, with the three ambiguities decided and recorded. D1/D2/D4 workarounds are in the draft; D3 avoided by size reduction.
